title: Preserve aspect ratio for scalable schematic boxes
goal: uses aspect-ratio to derive height when changing width.
summary: representation box shrinks in narrow viewports and caps in wide viewports, always using a 16:9 ratio.
tasks: retains the existing streaming width of .screen.
sets the aspect ratio to 16:9 and lets the browser calculate the height.

example.note: aspect-ratio is width and the rear term is height. The browser can calculate proportionally when the other dimension is auto.

hint: only writes aspect-ratio, which allows the height to follow the width; there is no need to fix the height here.
